caption: Each candidate version is tested against its range: 2 of the 4 versions fit ^4.18.2 (4.18.2 and 4.19.0) and 1 of the 2 fits ~1.2.3 (1.2.9). The grey cells are rejected because 5.0.0 and 1.3.0 sit exactly on an upper bound that is excluded.

spec.title: Which versions fit each range?
spec.aria: A table of candidate versions tested against two npm ranges: under ^4.18.2 the versions 4.18.2 and 4.19.0 are allowed while 4.17.1 and 5.0.0 are rejected, and under ~1.2.3 the version 1.2.9 is allowed while 1.3.0 is rejected.
